subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: Should OpenClaw adopt result-attached, yield-only runtime control as a supported public Plugin SDK contract?
rationale: The implementation appears correct and proven, but choosing the permanent external API shape and its unsupported-runtime semantics requires maintainer ownership rather than automated code judgment.

options.title: Sponsor the yield-only contract
options.body: Approve `AgentToolResult.control` and `yieldToolResult(...)` as the stable narrow handoff API and land the current documented behavior.

options.title: Hold for the broader interaction design
options.body: Pause this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102260 determines whether yield belongs in a more general structured-interaction contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the yield-only contract
recommendation.body: Approve `AgentToolResult.control` and `yieldToolResult(...)` as the stable narrow handoff API and land the current documented behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal connects this person to the embedded agent runtime and existing session-yield lifecycle being extended.
